purpose: Self-contained read-only remote capture of target-specific original power-range provenance.
copy_paste_prompt:
Work on this Windows machine in the existing Druta checkout. This phase is strictly read-only: do not issue power SETs, write registry or BIOS data, install drivers or applications, reboot, or run a workload. Do not reset, overwrite, or clean the checkout or any existing user edits. First inspect AGENTS.md, the current tree, branch/commit and relevant source; report any local modifications and preserve them. Use the adapter actually selected by the user, establishing its PCI slot with the checkout's existing read-only discovery and recording its identity. Do not assume a device or use a driver-version allowlist.

Capture to a new private directory outside the checkout, with an existing parent. The accompanying helper, if present in the checkout, is experiments/capture_power_provenance.py. Review its code and compatibility with this exact tree before running it. Run it with this checkout's existing Python and dependencies: <python> <checkout>/experiments/capture_power_provenance.py --repo <checkout> --slot <actual-pci-slot> --out <new-private-directory>. If a capture dependency is unavailable, report it and continue independent reads through already available methods; do not install a driver or system application for this capture. If the helper is absent or incompatible, use the checkout's existing typed read-only APIs directly; do not abandon the capture solely because the helper is absent.

For the direct path, bind the chosen GPU with druta.registry_overrides.bind_target(gpu); use druta.client_power_runtime.ClientPowerController(gpu).read_metadata() and .read() for metadata and full client/native INFO, CONTROL and ROLE packets, identity and binding. Save the raw packets and their sizes, retain errors independently, and compare metadata/full-read identity and binding. Use druta.registry_overrides.read_vbios(gpu) and druta.vbios_fields.inspect on the live image, and druta.registry_overrides.WindowsRegistry(target).snapshot() to capture the existing registry state. Use druta.power_range_baseline._original(target, snapshot, live_image) and the existing receipt/original validation path to establish whether an original image is actually verified; save the original image only if that check succeeds. Use power_range_baseline.read(gpu, metadata) for the product's original-range result. Re-bind the target after capture and report any change or unsupported/read failure. Preserve full packets and images as private artifacts, not public attachments.

Record the commit and SHA-256 hashes of the relevant source files and helper, packet sizes, complete binding/identity comparisons, image hashes, receipt provenance, parse errors, and the product's result. Capture the complete raw bytes of every v30 power-table row, its ordinal, stride and offset. Where the row is long enough for byte +0x42, record that entire byte and full encoded class ((row[0] & 0x0f) | ((row[0x42] & 0x0f) << 4)); otherwise report the class unavailable. Do not substitute the low nibble alone. Capture the same information for a verified original image. Compare original and live runtime class, channel, units and limits only through the typed binding/serialization established in this exact checkout; report unproved matches as unknown. A separate offline 595.97 trace established v30 full class 1 -> native class 0 and native INFO/ROLE field production; this does not establish this machine's original ROM, receipt provenance, live equality, universal geometry, or physical enforcement. Do not use a public ROM listing as proof of the installed or original image.

Return a concise summary with current checkout/version and local-change status, selected adapter identity, private artifact locations, capture errors, verified original source or why unavailable, observed full v30 classes, runtime-binding comparison, and whether an original range is established. Keep private identifiers, ROMs, registry data and raw captures off public services; share only with the requesting user through their chosen private channel. Any later mutation must go back to the coordinating root agent for a concrete reviewed request, exact readback and restoration plan; do not perform it in this phase.
helper_url_note: The helper and this handoff are part of codex/registry-controls. Review the exact current tree before running; the prompt also works when the helper is absent.
known_evidence: Offline 595.97 parser-to-native INFO and ROLE serializer closure is complete. Target original image/receipt provenance and live equality remain pending; driver versions are not eligibility gates.
scope: Read-only target APIs and local private capture only; no GPU or registry write, installation, restart, or workload.
local_validation: Existing helper passed offline synthetic checks and a full read-only modern-adapter capture; those results do not establish target Ampere behavior.
